prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1338; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with whiplash-type injury. The mechanism of injury described is plausible for the force and direction of this crash. Over the course of ten visits, care consisted of physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, manual therapy, and home exercise instruction, which followed a typical and expected progression. Pain and muscle guarding decreased steadily as the patient improved, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal tenderness that support the reported injury, while neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the neck or upper back is known from the patient history. Billing records reflect the services rendered without duplicate or repeated charges. Patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
